character_join: Elevation, shoreline distance, and large-metro distance are measured from the Census place centroid. Elevation is the GNIS populated place of the same name in the same state within 5 miles; it is left missing when none reports one. Large metros are Census metropolitan areas with 1,000,000+ people (ACS B01003); their principal cities are the places named in the metro title.
climate_join: Each place uses the nearest NOAA station within 30 miles that reports the needed normals, measured from the Census place centroid. Station elevation is not compared; values are left missing when no station qualifies.
excluded_geography: Puerto Rico places are not in the first catalog.

annual_precip_in.definition: Annual precipitation normal in inches, NOAA 1991-2020 ANN-PRCP-NORMAL, from the nearest station within 30 miles. Rain and melted snow; not a measure of sunshine.
annual_precip_in.label: Annual precipitation

annual_snowfall_in.definition: Annual snowfall normal in inches, NOAA 1991-2020 ANN-SNOW-NORMAL, from the nearest station within 30 miles that reports snowfall. Missing where none does; never assumed to be zero.
annual_snowfall_in.label: Annual snowfall

car_light_commute_share.definition: Share of workers 16+ who take public transit, bicycle, walk, or work from home (B08301_E010 + E018 + E019 + E021) / B08301_E001. An ACS commute-mode proxy, not a walkability score.
car_light_commute_share.label: Car-light commute share

college_educated_share.definition: Adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher (B15003_E022 + E023 + E024 + E025) / B15003_E001.
college_educated_share.label: College-educated share

elevation_ft.definition: Elevation of the USGS GNIS populated place with the same name in the same state nearest the Census place centroid, within 5 miles (GNIS ELEV_IN_FT, 2021-08-25 archive). Missing where no such place reports elevation.
elevation_ft.label: Elevation

freezing_nights_per_year.definition: Average days per year with a daily low at or below 32°F, NOAA 1991-2020 normal ANN-TMIN-AVGNDS-LSTH032, from the nearest station within 30 miles.
freezing_nights_per_year.label: Freezing nights

hospital_distance_mi.definition: Straight-line (great-circle) miles from the Census place centroid to the nearest hospital in the CMS Hospital General Information file whose Emergency Services field is Yes. A facility is located at the centroid of its ZIP Code Tabulation Area, so the distance can be off by a few miles. Not drive time and not a statement about service quality; the facility name is kept as provenance. Missing where the source holds no located emergency hospital; never imputed.
hospital_distance_mi.label: Nearest emergency hospital

hot_days_per_year.definition: Average days per year with a daily high at or above 90°F, NOAA 1991-2020 normal ANN-TMAX-AVGNDS-GRTH090, from the nearest station within 30 miles.
hot_days_per_year.label: Hot days (90°F+)

large_metro_distance_mi.definition: Great-circle miles from the Census place centroid to the nearest principal city of a metropolitan area with 1,000,000 or more people (ACS B01003 for the Census CBSA). Principal cities are the places named in the metro title; 0 for those cities.
large_metro_distance_mi.label: Distance to a large metro

large_metro_suburb.definition: 1 when the place is not itself a principal city of a metropolitan area over 1,000,000 people and lies within 25 miles of one; otherwise 0. A distance rule, not a Census urban-area designation.
large_metro_suburb.label: Large-metro suburb

median_home_value.definition: Median value of owner-occupied housing units, ACS B25077 (B25077_E001).
median_home_value.label: Median home value

population_density.definition: B01003_E001 divided by Gazetteer land area (ALAND_SQMI).
population_density.label: Population density

water_distance_mi.definition: Great-circle miles from the Census place centroid to the nearest ocean coastline or Great Lakes shore (Natural Earth 1:10m). Inland lakes and rivers are not counted. Measured to shoreline segments within 60 miles and to shoreline points under 4 miles apart beyond that.
water_distance_mi.label: Distance to ocean or Great Lake

geography: U.S. states and DC: incorporated places and Census-designated places
hospital_join: Each place uses the nearest hospital in the pinned CMS Hospital General Information file whose Emergency Services field is Yes, in straight-line (great-circle) miles from the Census place centroid. A facility is located at the centroid of its ZIP Code Tabulation Area; a facility whose ZIP Code is not a ZCTA is left out. There is no distance cap, drive time is not estimated, and the value is left missing only when no located facility exists. The facility id, name, and miles are kept per place.

cms_hospitals.vintage: CMS Hospital General Information (xubh-q36u), modified 2026-07-22, released 2026-08-13

natural_earth_coastline.vintage: Natural Earth 1:10m physical vectors v5.1.2 (public domain)

natural_earth_lakes.vintage: Natural Earth 1:10m physical vectors v5.1.2 (public domain)

noaa_normals.vintage: NOAA U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020 v1.0.1 (annual/seasonal, by station)

zcta_gazetteer.vintage: 2024 Census Gazetteer, ZIP Code Tabulation Areas

sentinel_policy: Every negative ACS estimate (including -666666666 and -999999999) becomes null.
